evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: An engineering-first mindset, reflected in your hands-on experience with Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and structured data modelling methodologies like Kimball or Data Vault.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour — 'engineering-first mindset', robust CI/CD, Kimball/Data Vault modelling and 'source of truth' guardianship outweigh the scale-up pace language in the company blurb.
evidence.domain_risk: you will be the primary architect of our data's "source of truth."
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate — a marketplace's business decisions depend on the semantic layer, but no financial reporting, audit or regulatory consequence is named.
evidence.collaboration_width: Marketing; Finance; GTM Ops; Data Engineering
evidence.data_team_maturity: You will lead a team of high-performing Analytics Engineers dedicated to transforming raw data into actionable insights through a sophisticated Looker semantic layer.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid — an Analytics Engineering team, a separate Data Engineering team and a Looker semantic layer already exist, but the JD explicitly warns 'if you prefer a stable environment with clear processes and structures... you won't always find that here'.
evidence.jd_authorship: You'll serve as the main guardian of our Looker architecture, establishing robust CI/CD pipelines in GitLab and partnering with Data Engineering to optimize table structures.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: hiring_manager — tools are named with precise application context (LookML, Liquid, GitLab CI/CD, table-structure optimisation), so the day-to-day is legible.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: you will work closely with cross-functional partners in Marketing, Finance, and GTM Ops to turn complex business needs into scalable data models
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Mixed — commercial partners (Marketing, GTM Ops) and Finance are named with equal weight and both recur in the nice-to-haves ('across GTM and Finance').
evidence.autonomy_level: you will be the primary architect of our data's "source of truth" ... shaping the future of our data ecosystem by mentoring team members, managing sprint priorities, and driving a high-performance culture
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic — the role architects the data ecosystem, sets sprint priorities and drives team culture rather than delivering scoped work.
evidence.ai_role: integrating AI Agents into conversational analytics workflows
evidence.ai_role_explanation: ai_enabler — both signals are present (using 'AI solutions to automate repetitive workflows' and building analytics that AI agents operate over), and the tie-breaker resolves to enabler.
evidence.testing_framing: establishing robust CI/CD pipelines in GitLab
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility — the candidate is accountable for establishing the engineering quality gates around the semantic layer, framed with an ownership verb rather than listed as a familiar tool.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: you will be the primary architect of our data's "source of truth." ... You'll serve as the main guardian of our Looker architecture
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High — 'source of truth' and 'guardian' open the role summary, framing the job around protecting company-wide trust in the numbers.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Real-world experience migrating legacy analytics environments over to Looker
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed — establishing new CI/CD pipelines sits alongside migrating legacy environments and optimising existing table structures.
evidence.language_gate: At a minimum we require fluent English language skills (C1). Why? English is our company language
evidence.work_arrangement: We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first. Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works.
evidence.loss_aversion: 'You'll serve as the main guardian of our Looker architecture' — the role is framed as protecting the integrity of the company's single source of truth.
